Court Orders Case Registration Against Actor Tini Tom

A court in Kerala has directed the police to register a case against actor Tini Tom following a complaint filed by Ansiba. The complaint reportedly pertains to a remark made by Tom, described as a 'Jihadi' remark by one outlet. The specifics of the complaint and the alleged remark are not detailed further in the provided coverage.
